stories.title: LIVE | Springboks and Ireland set for Aviva Stadium showdown in Nations Championship
stories.summary: The Springboks are preparing for a significant Nations Championship match against Ireland. South African flyer Kurt-Lee Arendse is expected to be a key player in this exciting showdown.
stories.angle: The Springboks' participation in this international championship highlights South Africa's presence in global sports.

stories.title: Durban hospital performs record 11 life-saving heart surgeries on children
stories.summary: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in Durban has successfully performed a record 11 life-saving paediatric heart surgeries. This surgical marathon, involving local and international specialists, brings hope to children and families across KwaZulu-Natal.
stories.angle: This medical milestone represents significant progress in paediatric healthcare in South Africa.
